title: Protocol to Reprogram Human Menstrual Blood-Derived Stromal Cells to Generate AOX15-iPSCs
protocol: Prepare 15 mL tubes containing 3 mL of Ficoll (Histopaque 1077-Sigma) and bring to 25°C.
Carefully layer the menstrual blood sample onto the Ficoll Histopaque-1077.
Transfer menstrual blood sample drop by drop on the tube wall containing Ficoll.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 30 minutes at 25°C to pellet red blood cells.
Recover supernatant containing MnSCs and transfer into a clean 50 mL tube.
Add 10 mL of DPBS with 1% penicillin/streptomycin (P/S) to the recovered supernatant.
Mix by gently drawing in and out using a 10 mL pipette.
Centrifuge at 250 × g for 10 minutes to pellet stromal cells.
Discard supernatant.
Repeat steps with DPBS, P/S washing twice more.
Resuspend cell pellet with 1 mL of MnSC medium using a p1000 micropipette.
Add 6 mL of MnSC medium and transfer the cell suspension into a T25 cell culture flask.
Place the flask in a 5% CO2, 37°C incubator.
Change MnSC medium every other day.
When cells reach 80%-90% confluency (usually after 5-7 days), dissociate them by adding 1 mL of 0.05% trypsin-EDTA to the T25 flask.
Incubate for 5-10 minutes at 37°C.
Add 5 mL of MnSC medium to inactivate the trypsin and mix well using a 5 mL pipette.
Plate cells at a density of 10^4 cells/cm^2.
Split cells every four to five days to maintain 80% confluence.
Seed ~5 × 10^6 cells of HEK293T cells onto a 100 mm tissue culture plate and culture for 24–48 hours in 293T medium.
Split cells at a 1:4 ratio when they reach 100% confluency.
Allow cells to reach 80%-90% confluency.
Remove medium from the cells.
Replace with 10 mL fresh pre-warmed growth medium 1-2 hours before transfection.
Add 60 μL PEI (1 μg/μL in water, pH7) drop by drop while vortexing at medium speed to a DNA mixture.
Vortex briefly for 30 seconds and leave the mixture for 10 minutes at 25°C.
Add the mixture dropwise in a circular motion to the 293T cells.
Gently rock the plate back and forth and side-to-side to ensure even distribution of the transfection mixture.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator for 8 hours.
Aspirate the medium after 8 hours.
Add 6 mL of 293T medium.
Do not exceed 12 hours post-transfection.
Collect supernatant using a disposable syringe approximately 36 hours after transfection.
Filter the collected supernatant through a 0.45 μm syringe filter into a 50 mL conical tube.
Use the filtered supernatant for cell transduction or store at 4°C for 17-18 hours.
For short-term storage, freeze supernatants at -20°C (up to 1 month).
For long-term storage, freeze supernatants at -80°C (up to 6 months).
Gently add 6 mL of fresh 293T medium down the side of the culture plate and incubate for 24 hours.
Repeat virus collection on day 4 as previously done.
Filter an additional 8 mL of medium into a 50 mL conical tube.
Use the filtered supernatant for cell transduction or store as in previous steps.
The day before transduction, plate 6 x 10^5 293T cells in a 6-well plate (10^5 cells/well).
On day 1, add 1 mL or 3 mL of viral supernatant to each well for pMX-SOX15, pMX-ASF1A, and pMX-OCT4.
Incubate the wells containing viral supernatants in a 37°C, 5% CO2 tissue culture incubator for 24 hours.
Replace medium with 2 mL/well of 293T medium.
Incubate for 72 h, replacing the medium 48 h after transduction on day 4.
Dissociate transduced and control (non-transduced) 293T cells with 0.05% Trypsin/EDTA.
Resuspend pellet with 1 mL of 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA).
Incubate for 20 min at 25°C to fix the cells.
Wash cells by adding 10 mL of DPBS, then centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 5 min.
Repeat washing step once again.
Resuspend cells with 0.5–1 mL PBS-0.1% BSA-150 mM EDTA-0.02% sodium azide.
Analyze cells by flow cytometry.
Pause point: store cells at 4°C for up to 1 week if not analyzing immediately.
Analyze GFP positive cells by flow cytometry.
Plate 10^5 MnSCs into 35 mm cell culture plates the day before reprogramming.
Add 5 mL of each pMX-SO15, pMX-ASF1A, and pMX-OCT4 retroviral supernatant (MOI=5 for each vector) along with 15 μL of 8 μg/mL polybrene per plate 24 hours later.
Replace the medium with 5 mL of MnSC medium on day 2.
Dissociate cells and plate 5 × 10^4 cells/well in a 6-well plate containing iMEFs using hES medium as the final medium on day 4.
Change the hES medium daily from day 4 onwards.
Collect reprogrammed cells for characterization of pluripotency markers when they transform to round-shaped morphology between days 14 and 21.
